member.name: Public sector entities
member.description:
public sector entity' means a non-commercial administrative body responsible to central governments, regional
governments or local authorities, or to authorities that
exercise the same responsibilities as regional governments
and local authorities, or a non-commercial undertaking
that is owned by or set up and sponsored by central
governments, regional governments or local authorities,
and that has explicit guarantee arrangements, and may
include self-administered bodies governed by law that are
under public supervision;
